heading: Cargo exempt from forfeiture
lead: Cargo on a vessel is exempt from forfeiture under this title if—

tree.text: the cargo is owned in good faith by a person not the owner, master, or crewmember of the vessel; and
the customs duties on the cargo have been paid or secured for payment as provided by law.
